# Cigna Healthcare

> Cigna Healthcare provides comprehensive health insurance, dental plans, and wellness solutions for individuals, families, employers, and healthcare providers.

Cigna Healthcare is a major insurance provider offering medical, dental, and supplemental coverage options across individual, family, and group plans. The site serves multiple audiences including members, employers, brokers, and healthcare providers with plan shopping, enrollment, and member support resources.

## Key Topics

- Health Insurance Plans
- Dental Insurance
- Medicare
- Open Enrollment
- Special Enrollment
- Group Health Insurance
- Individual Plans
- Employee Benefits
- HSA/HRA/FSA
- myCigna Portal
- HIPAA Compliance
- Plan Comparison
- Employer Solutions
- Member Support
- Cigna Global

## Shop Plans & Coverage

- [Affordable Health Insurance Plans for Individuals and Families](https://www.cigna.com/individuals-families/shop-plans/health-insurance-plans): Browse individual and family health insurance plans with affordable coverage options.
- [Affordable Dental Insurance Plans for Individuals](https://www.cigna.com/individuals-families/shop-plans/dental-insurance-plans): Dental insurance plans and coverage options for individuals and families.
- [Plans Offered Through Your Employer](https://www.cigna.com/individuals-families/shop-plans/plans-through-employer): Employer-offered medical, dental, and vision plans enrollment information.
- [Group Health Insurance Plans for Employers](https://www.cigna.com/employers): Employer group health insurance plans with customizable benefits solutions.

## Member Resources & Support

- [Member Guide](https://www.cigna.com/individuals-families/member-guide): Member resources for plan management, claims, prescriptions, and benefits.
- [Knowledge Center](https://www.cigna.com/knowledge-center): Central hub for insurance, Medicare, health, and wellness educational articles.
- [Disaster Resource Center](https://www.cigna.com/knowledge-center/disaster-resource-center): Disaster preparedness and recovery resources for members and families.

## Insurance Education & Enrollment

- [How to Buy Health Insurance and Choose the Right Plan](https://www.cigna.com/knowledge-center/how-to-buy-health-insurance): Guide to buying health insurance with plan selection and comparison tips.
- [Health Insurance Open Enrollment and Special Enrollment](https://www.cigna.com/knowledge-center/open-enrollment-special-enrollment): Information on open enrollment periods and special enrollment eligibility.
- [Types of Dental Insurance](https://www.cigna.com/knowledge-center/types-of-dental-insurance): Educational guide on different dental insurance types and plan options.

## Business & Provider Solutions

- [Cigna Healthcare for Brokers](https://www.cigna.com/brokers): Broker services and portal for health insurance plan sales and support.
- [Health Care Providers](https://www.cigna.com/health-care-providers): Provider resources for coverage, claims, credentialing, and HIPAA compliance.

## Optional

- [Flu Symptoms, Prevention, and Treatment](https://www.cigna.com/knowledge-center/flu): Health education on flu symptoms, prevention, and treatment options.
